reviews.text: Great experience with Legacy Roofing! Tony was professional, honest, and easy to work with throughout the entire process. Ryan, the QCM, made sure everything was done right and paid close attention to detail. The job went smoothly, and I’m very happy with my new roof. Highly recommend!
reviews.author: Claire L.

reviews.text:
I can’t say enough good things about working with Rhett Hansen at Legacy Roofing. As a REALTOR®, I rely on honest and responsive professionals, and Rhett went above and beyond.

Another roofing company had given my clients a completely inaccurate report on a roof that had just been replaced in March. Rhett came out right away, did a thorough inspection, and even contacted that company directly to go over his findings. Thanks to him, they corrected their report.

Even though the buyers ended up terminating due to the stress of the situation, Rhett proved himself to be professional, knowledgeable, and truly an advocate for homeowners. He’s definitely earned my trust and future business, and I would highly recommend him to anyone needing a reliable roofer in North Texas.
reviews.author: Ana Porto

reviews.text:
After hail damage to my roof, this company made the entire replacement process stress-free. They handled all communication with my insurance company and got the claim approved smoothly. Even though the insurance only covered standard 30-year shingles, they upgraded my roof to impact-resistant shingles at no extra cost, which not only improved my roof’s quality but also lowered my insurance premium.

On top of that, they went above and beyond by cleaning my air vents and resealing all my windows as a complimentary service. The work was done professionally, and they provided all the necessary certificates and warranties at the end. Their attention to detail and customer care truly stood out. Highly recommend!
reviews.author: SIHEL EXPRESS LLC Admin

reviews.text: I definitely give Legacy Roofing FIVE starts. Their work is excellent and they were able to repair my roof promptly and thoroughly. I highly recommend the way that they came out to my home quickly and they were great to work with.
reviews.author: Michele Steed

reviews.text: I opened a business 3 years ago and trusted Rhett and the team with my pursuit of becoming a successful business owner. Now after 3 years, they have done such a great job that I've had to do no repairs and everything still has that new business shine. Appreciate them so much for bringing my vision to life!
reviews.author: Caleb Klous (FitGamer)

reviews.text:
There was a company that came to help me with my roof, but they didn’t know how to get it approved by my insurance company. After legacy came by they worked directly with my insurance company to get it all approved and covered with the correct storm date.

They made me feel very comfortable, and were very honest throughout the process. The guys who were working on the roof were friendly and cleaned up after themselves very well. Now I have had people come by and tell me how great my new roof looks!
reviews.author: Linda Elliott

reviews.text:
I spoke to Rico about a sky light that was leaking from the storms Tuesday morning 05/28 and they were out the next day.

Walter and Rico are wonderful, polite and professional.

I give Legacy Roofing & Construction a 5 star rating.   Best company ever.

When I do need a roof replacement, Legacy Roofing & Construction is whom I  will call.

Thank you, MB Walker.
reviews.author: Melinda B. Walker

reviews.text: We have used Legacy roofing for many of our home projects.  They have replaced our roof, painted the exterior of our home as well as the interior.  When we had a busted pipe that caused water damage in our kitchen, they were able make new cabinets that matched perfectly with the undamaged cabinets.  They are very professional and know how to work with insurance companies.
reviews.author: Stephanie Vaughn
